atmModels.description: ATM models: World props that work as ATMs (needs ai-target).

atmLimit.description: ATM limit per action: Most one ATM withdrawal or transfer moves. Bank branches have no limit.

atmDailyLimit.description: ATM limit per day: Most one character withdraws and transfers through ATMs in 24 hours. Counted in memory: a restart of ai-banking starts every count again.

transferFee.description: Transfer fee: Percent added to transfers to other players (0 = free).
